description: Agent Water Records: submit a well holder’s construction and registration records with the closure entries they answer to: each well the well record lists with its id, reference, name, status (active, inactive or abandoned), the depth and the location it states; each registration entry with its id, reference, the well, the location it states and the moment registered; each construction log with its id, reference, the well, the depth it records and the moment completed; each closure or sealing entry with its id, reference, the well and the moment sealed. The signed report gives the wells and the records behind them, each listed well against a registration entry, each depth the well record states against the latest construction log, each location against the latest registration, and each abandoned well against a closure entry, and counts them, and names divergent water well records: a listed well with no registration entry, a well depth the construction log does not support, a well location the registration does not state, and an abandoned well with no closure entry; then a construction log and a registration entry naming a well the record does not list, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No well list, no registration entries beside wells, or no construction logs beside stated depths leaves those points unverified. Wells and entries match by letters and digits, locations without case or punctuation, depths to the hundredth in the unit the record uses. This reads the holder’s own construction and registration records for each well: wever_build-permit-check reads a building permit filing against the plans and inspections, while the well record check reads whether every well is registered, logged as built, located as registered and closed when abandoned. Verdict water_well_record_divergent, water_well_record_partial, water_well_record_unverified or water_well_record_consistent. POST /api/water-well-record-check. Reads the water records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it operates no system, takes no sample, contacts no regulator, customer or other utility and issues no certification, approval or water right decision, which stay with the utility, its operators and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Water Records reads records held by a water utility or water system operator: water system records with operator certifications, water quality test records from the sampling chain to the results, treatment plant records, discharge monitoring records, meter records, backflow test records and well records, and a water right’s own record, whoever holds it, each against the facility, certification, connection and survey records, the sampling plan, holding times and limits, the operating log, chemical stock and calibrations, the outfalls, discharge limits and monitoring reports, the reading history, the assembly, repair and tester records, the registration, construction and closure records, or the diversions and reported use on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the water system: what the system record lists, what the sampling chain and the treatment log support, what the discharge, meter and backflow records show, and whether the well and water right records hold up; it reads by record holder, not by the water itself: the Agent Agriculture Records family reads a farm’s irrigation and water-use records against its allocation, the Agent Energy family reads utility bills and tariffs, and the Agent Waste and Recycling Records family reads waste manifests and disposal records, while this family reads the utility’s, the operator’s and the right’s own records and reads none of those. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-water-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-water-records/.
